headline: One-time settlement gain masks deepening operating losses
summary_short: Roivant swung to net income of $303.0 million ($0.28 diluted EPS) in the quarter ended March 31, 2026, from a $206.5 million loss a year earlier, driven by a $770.2 million gain from Genevant's Moderna patent settlement; operating loss widened to $355.0 million on revenue of $2.5 million.
summary_long: Fiscal Q4 (quarter ended March 31, 2026) net income of $303.0 million reflects a $770.2 million pretax gain from Genevant's patent-litigation settlement with Moderna, not operating improvement — operating loss widened to $355.0 million y/y as R&D and G&A kept climbing for the full fiscal year (R&D +$131.4M to $681.8M annually, driven by anti-FcRn franchise and batoclimab wind-down costs; G&A +$19.1M to $610.5M, driven by share-based compensation and a $17.1M HQ-relocation impairment). Cash and equivalents fell to $1,419.2 million from $2,715.4 million y/y, partly reflecting $314.9 million of full-year share buybacks. Total cash, equivalents and marketable securities stood at $4.3 billion. No quantified forward guidance was given; management says existing liquidity is sufficient for the foreseeable future.
